title: Apple reveals touchscreen MacBook Pro at event
excerpt: Apple wrapped up its week of product announcements with a Pro and Tell event, featuring a long-rumored touchscreen MacBook Pro and other updates.
body_html:
Apple concluded a week of product announcements by hosting a Pro and Tell event. During the presentation, the company unveiled its long-rumored touchscreen MacBook Pro.

While this device was the final announcement of the week, Apple also revealed several other device upgrades and updates in the days leading up to the event.
